en: What's really nice about this desktop app is
that you can of course quickly see which

expand this here to
get a detailed view of what was deleted in
red and what was added in green, which is of
course very convenient.
And in addition, in this desktop app here in
the top right,
you'll also have this
Div Panel Toggle, and if you click that, you

changed here on the right. So I'll quickly
hide my sidebar here on the left to have a
bit more room.
And here you see, you get a list of all the
files that were changed, and of course right
now it's only one.
You can take a look at it and see what was
changed. Now important, this is not what was
changed by the model necessarily. This is
what changed since the last Git commit, and
since I only had an initial commit, the
entire spec.md file is new. So that's the

Here in this preview,
I see what changed compared to the last
